column2: [intro]
My phone, my passion
I can't live without it, it's my obsession
I'm addicted to this glowing screen
Ready to grab anything, even the unseen
Addicted to my phone, I forget all the rest
I'm stuck in this world, feeling so oppressed
I swipe right, I swipe left
But I realize my life's bereft
My friends talk to me, I ignore them
My phone has become my precious gem
I prefer emojis to real smiles
But I feel empty, trapped in these virtual miles
Addicted to my phone, I forget all the rest
I'm stuck in this world, feeling so oppressed
I like, I comment, I share my mind
But I realize my life's left behind
[ solo ]
Goodbye my phone, I'm free at last
I soar to new heights, leave the past
I enjoy moments, no filters, no likes
Real life's beautiful, I finally see the light
[outro]
